# Utilities

The Utilities category has 7 tasks. Each entry shows the task's latest revision, the one the palette adds. See [Reading an entry](./overview#reading-an-entry).

## Execute Advanced HTTP Call

Execute an Advanced HTTP Call

- **Slug:** `execute-advanced-http-call`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 4
- **Image:** Default task image.

> **Warning:** Every revision sends no request and ends `succeeded` on `boomerangio/task-flow:3.3.0`, the default task image, so a later task that reads `response` or `statusCode` gets nothing. The fix is in task-flow 3.4.0, which isn't released. See [The HTTP Call tasks do nothing](../introduction/known-issues#the-http-call-tasks-do-nothing).

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| URL | `url` | URL | No |  |  |
| Method | `method` | Select | No |  |  |
| Headers | `header` | Text Area | No |  | Headers to add to the request, such as Authorization |
| Content Type | `contentType` | Text | No |  |  |
| Body | `body` | Text Editor | No |  |  |
| Allow Untrusted SSL Certs | `allowUntrustedCerts` | Boolean | No |  |  |
| Response File Path | `outputFilePath` | Text | No |  | File path to store the output response |
| HTTP response codes for successful execution | `successcodes` | Text | No | `1xx,2xx` |  |
| HTTP response codes for failure | `errorcodes` | Text | No |  | HTTP response codes which marks the call as failed |
| HTTP response codes for execution retry | `retrycodes` | Text | No | `502,503` | HTTP response codes for retry |
| Number of milliseconds to wait until the next retry | `retrydelay` | Number | No |  | Cool down between retries in millis (100, 300000) |
| Number of retries | `retrynumber` | Number | No | `3` | Number of retries to be attempted, between (1, 9) |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `response` | HTTP execution response content |
| `statusCode` | The received HTTP status code |

## Run Python Script

Execute a Python script. The returned result of the script is returned as the result value of the task.

- **Slug:** `run-python-script`
- **Type:** `script`
- **Revision:** 2
- **Image:** `boomerangio/worker-python:0.0.3`

> **Warning:** Revision 1 does nothing and ends `succeeded`: the command it calls is no longer in the task image. Later revisions work. Upgrade a node pinned to revision 1 in the editor. See [Some older task revisions do nothing](../introduction/known-issues#some-older-task-revisions-do-nothing).

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Python Version | `pythonVersion` | Select, read-only | Yes |  | Python 3 or Python 2 only. |
| Additional Python Packages | `pythonPackages` | Text Editor - Text | No |  | "Requirement specifier format": www.ibm.biz/BdfMmj |
| Python Arguments | `pythonArguments` | Text | No |  | Command line arguments. |
| Python Script | `pythonScript` | Text Editor | Yes |  | Python script to execute. |
| Output file path | `outputFilePath` | Text | No |  | File path where the script output will be written. |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `output` | Python script standard output standard and error content. |
